create.warning: Write down these 24 words in order. This is the only way to recover your wallet. Never share them with anyone.
create.verifyInstructions: Verify your recovery phrase by entering the following words. Start typing and select the matching word.

import.instructions: Enter your 24-word recovery phrase. Start typing each word and select from the suggestions.

password.description: Set a wallet password to encrypt your recovery phrase. You will need this password each time you open the app.
password.label: Password

errors.passwordRequirements: Password does not meet all requirements
errors.copyFailedBody: Could not copy mnemonic to clipboard.
errors.clipboardUnavailableBody: Could not access clipboard. Try pasting directly into the word fields with Ctrl+V.

delete.title: Delete Wallet?
delete.description: This will remove the encrypted wallet from this device. Your funds are safe if you have your 24-word recovery phrase backed up. You can re-import it after deleting.
delete.warning: Without your recovery phrase, your funds will be permanently lost.
delete.acknowledge: I have backed up my 24-word recovery phrase
